roleZh: 引出栅极 G 与 Kelvin 源极信号，连接外部栅极驱动器。
roleEn: Routes gate G and Kelvin-source signals to an external gate driver.
featuresZh: Kelvin 回路与主功率回路分开，减少共源电感对驱动电压的影响。
featuresEn: A separate Kelvin return reduces the effect of common-source inductance on gate voltage.
materialZh: 铜合金针，常见镀锡或镀镍表面。
materialEn: Copper-alloy pins, commonly tin or nickel plated.
